links.outcome: Rheumatologist-rated accuracy of LLM versus physician responses to patient questions
links.effect: Rheumatologists rated AI accuracy 6.48 ± 2.07 vs physician 9.08 ± 0.64 (P < 0.0001); patients identified AI answers at only 0.49 vs 0.97 for physicians.
links.quote: However, rheumatologists rated AI responses significantly poorer than physician-generated responses, suggesting that LLM chatbot responses are inferior to physician responses, a difference that patients may not be aware of.

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing LLM chatbot-generated responses against physician-generated responses to rheumatology patient questions, evaluated offline by both patients and physicians.
